doc.title: Jon Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 17, 2003 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Opening and welcome to Hamilton
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Jon Jang and the Hamilton archive; light banter about Jang's talks with students.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are at Hamilton College filming for the Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have pianist and composer Jon Jang with me today, and welcome to Hamilton.
I’ve overheard some of your conversations with students and you’ve said some great things. I hope I don’t make you repeat yourself too much.
Oh well I don’t even remember, and I don’t even remember if they were great so —
